content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Tax, valuation and advisory services for individuals and businesses, not management services for publicly traded REITs."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced HR, payroll and workers' compensation for small businesses; no real estate or REIT management business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Franchised insurance agency earning carrier commissions from households and small businesses, unrelated to REIT management."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Consulting and managed revenue-cycle services for hospitals, universities and corporations, not REIT management."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Government and industrial engineering, construction and operations contracts; project-based services rather than REIT management fees."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Mechanical, electrical and plumbing trade contracting and building systems work, not managing REITs or their properties for fees."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings and earns rent from tenants, rather than earning management fees from REITs."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases shopping centers to retailers, earning rent as an asset owner rather than managing REITs for fees."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Water, environmental and infrastructure engineering consulting sold to government clients, not REIT management services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage and program administration earning carrier commissions, a different business from REIT management."}]}
